description: This file defines PlayerActivity, an Android activity responsible for playing a media URL using ExoPlayer. It initializes the player, loads media from a URL passed via intent extras, and manages the player's lifecycle.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An activity that plays a single media URL using ExoPlayer, managing media lifecycle and UI binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the player and loads the media URL into ExoPlayer when activity is created.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Pauses the media playback when the activity is stopped.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases the ExoPlayer resources when the activity is destroyed.
